historic_survey.note: The church of the Most Holy Redeemer parish complex, which the statement names as the study area's one complex of resources associated with religious communities and puts forward as possibly eligible for the California Register on three separate grounds. The statement dates the church 1901 in its narrative and figure caption and 1900 in the Classical Revival style chapter.

historical_record.description: The Archdiocese of San Francisco established the Most Holy Redeemer parish to serve the Irish, German and Italian Catholic population of Eureka Valley, holding the first services in the then-vacant Eureka Valley Hall on Hartford Street.

The completed church held a parish hall in the basement, a sanctuary seating 750 people and a scheme of classical interior ornament. Some time after 1955 it lost its south tower and the dome and cupola on the north tower.
